fault_injection.design: v2: replayed full evidence incl. full HSE06; single-turn verifier, tools off
fault_injection.v1_note: v1 replayed only scissor gaps; verifier rejected all 24 incl. clean controls (runs/faults/results.json)

formalization.objective: minimise elastic strain energy density h(e) (meV/A^3)
constraints: Full HSE06 gap in 1.9-2.0 eV, target about 1.95 (verify_hse is the only valid check)
CBM is a Delta (X-like) valley
Born stability: all stiffness eigenvalues > 0
formalization.level_of_theory: Search at PBE + per-valley HSE scissor, shifted to a scissor window of 2.05-2.15 eV (kappa=0.5) to offset the observed scissor over-estimate of about 0.15 eV. Acceptance only at full HSE06.
formalization.subspace: All six Green-Lagrange Voigt components free, |e| <= 0.09
formalization.stability: Born check required at the final state. It was not rerun for this candidate.

formalization.objective: minimise elastic strain energy density h(e) (meV/A^3) over a homogeneous Green-Lagrange strain e
constraints: HSE06 gap Eg = 2.0 eV (window about 1.95-2.05); PBE+per-valley scissor is only a proxy, with a measured error of about 0.13 eV at large strain
Gap is indirect with a Dx/Dz CBM, not Gamma
Born stability: all stiffness eigenvalues > 0 (not re-run, check denied)
formalization.level_of_theory: HSE06 target; searched with PBE+scissor, scissor offset about -0.13 eV
formalization.subspace: full 6-component Voigt strain (e11,e22,e33,e23,e13,e12), tensor shear, bound 0.1
formalization.stability: Born stability required; previous verifier found the old candidate stable (min eigenvalue 369.6 GPa); not re-run for this candidate

H1_s3.eg_level: HSE06 (full, verify_hse at the candidate strain)

formalization.objective: minimise elastic strain energy density h(e) in meV/A^3 for diamond C
constraints: HSE06 band gap in [1.9, 2.0] eV (target 2.0 eV), evaluated with full HSE06 at the final strain and not the zero-strain scissor
Born stability: all eigenvalues of the stiffness matrix at the strained state > 0
strain is Green-Lagrange, Voigt order, tensor shear, fractions
formalization.level_of_theory: PBE for search and h; HSE06 required for the gap; hse_scissor (zero-strain per-valley corrections) used only as a screening proxy
formalization.stability: Born stability via elastic_stability at the final strain; not run on this candidate

H2_o1.eg_level: full HSE06 (verify_hse); scissor-HSE 0.797 eV; PBE 0.215 eV; indirect, CBM Dx

formalization.objective: Minimise the elastic strain energy density h(ε) in meV/Å^3.
constraints: Eg ≤ 0.80 eV (1239.84/1550 nm), so 1550 nm photons can be absorbed; a direct gap is not required (phonon-assisted absorption at an indirect gap is allowed)
Eg evaluated at HSE06 level: screened with per-valley scissor corrections on PBE valley energies (Δ +0.582, L +0.763, Γ +0.764 eV), to be confirmed by full HSE06
Born stability: all eigenvalues of the elastic stiffness matrix at the strained state must be positive
formalization.level_of_theory: PBE DFT for h and valley energies; HSE06 (scissor, then full verify_hse) for the gap constraint
formalization.subspace: All 6 Green-Lagrange Voigt components (e11,e22,e33,e23,e13,e12), each bounded to |ε| ≤ 0.10
formalization.stability: Born elastic stability (elastic_stability) required at the final strain

formalization.objective: minimise elastic strain energy density h (meV/A^3) over GL strain
constraints: Eg <= 0.80 eV (1550 nm) at HSE06 level (hse_scissor used as proxy; target <=0.78-0.79 for margin). Indirect gap acceptable (phonon-assisted absorption)
Born elastic stability: all stiffness eigenvalues > 0 at the strained state
formalization.level_of_theory: PBE DFT for sampling; hse_scissor (per-valley zero-strain HSE corrections) for the constraint; full HSE06 verification intended for final candidate
formalization.subspace: all 6 Voigt GL components, |normal|<=0.05, |shear|<=0.03; optimiser favoured pure normal strain
formalization.stability: Born stability required at the final strain (elastic_stability, 12 units)

H2_s2.eg_level: Full HSE06 (verify_hse). The scissor estimate is 0.786 eV and PBE is 0.204 eV.

formalization.objective: minimise elastic strain energy density h (meV/A^3)

formalization.level_of_theory: PBE DFT for sampling, with per-valley HSE06 scissor (Dx/Dy/Dz 0.582 eV, L 0.763 eV, G 0.764 eV); full HSE06 verification not run
formalization.subspace: all 6 Green-Lagrange Voigt components, normal |e|<=0.04, shear |e|<=0.03 (search bound 0.04)
formalization.stability: Born elastic stability required; check was denied (tool permission) so it is NOT verified

H2_s3.eg_level: Full HSE06 (verify_hse). The HSE-scissor value is 0.753 eV and the PBE value is 0.171 eV.

constraints: Eg <= 0.80 eV (photon energy at 1550 nm), evaluated at HSE06 level (HSE-scissor in search; target 0.78 eV for margin)

Eg <= 0 eV (gap closed) evaluated at HSE06-corrected level (PBE valley energies + per-valley HSE scissor), not bare PBE
|strain components| <= 0.08

formalization.objective: minimise elastic strain energy density h(e) (meV/A^3)
constraints: e33 = 0 (no normal strain perpendicular to (001))
Eg <= -0.02 eV (gap closed, small margin), evaluated at HSE06-scissor level, optimised with kappa=1 uncertainty margin
strain components within |e|<=0.08 (normal), |shear|<=0.05
formalization.level_of_theory: PBE DFT valley energies plus per-valley HSE06 scissor corrections fitted at zero strain. Full HSE06 verification was not run because the verify_hse call was denied.
formalization.subspace: free Voigt components e11, e22, e23, e13, e12 (Green-Lagrange, tensor shear); e33 fixed at 0
formalization.stability: Born stability was not checked (elastic_stability costs 12 units and was not run).

formalization.objective: minimize elastic strain energy density h (meV/A^3) of Si
constraints: Eg <= 0 eV (metal; CBM at or below VBM), evaluated at HSE06-scissor level (PBE valley energies plus zero-strain HSE corrections; G 0.764, L 0.763, D 0.582 eV). The PBE gap alone is not enough because PBE underestimates the Si gap (0.607 vs 1.189 eV at zero strain).
Target margin Eg <= -0.05 eV at hse_scissor to cover the surrogate error (holdout MAE 0.043 eV)
formalization.subspace: All 6 Green-Lagrange Voigt components free, |strain| <= 0.08 (normal) and 0.06 (shear)
formalization.stability: Born elastic stability not checked (12-unit cost). At h of about 2.5 meV/A^3 the state is well below the ideal-strength regime, but this is not verified.
formalization.level_of_theory: hse_scissor for the search and ranking; PBE DFT with internal relaxation for the data. Full HSE06 verification not run (tool denied).

T1_s2.eg_level: Full HSE06 (verify_hse); PBE -0.652 eV; HSE06-scissor -0.07 eV

formalization.objective: minimise elastic strain energy density h (meV/A^3) of Si
constraints: Eg <= 0 eV (metal), evaluated at HSE06-scissor-corrected level (per-valley corrections: G 0.764, L 0.763, X 0.582 eV); with a small safety margin (target about -0.03 eV) because surrogate holdout MAE is about 0.045 eV
PBE-level gap is already negative at these strains, but it is not the target level because PBE underestimates the zero-strain gap (0.61 vs 1.19 eV HSE)
formalization.subspace: all 6 Green-Lagrange Voigt components free, |e| <= 0.08 (surrogate optimisation); DFT sampling normals <= 0.08, shears <= 0.06
formalization.level_of_theory: PBE DFT with HSE06 per-valley scissor for the constraint; full HSE06 verification was attempted but denied
formalization.stability: Born elastic stability was desired but the check was denied, so the result is unverified

formalization.objective: minimise elastic strain energy density h(e) (meV/A^3), Green-Lagrange strain
constraints: Gamma is the CBM by >= 0.06 eV over the lowest competing valley (L or Delta), evaluated at the hse_scissor level with kappa=1 (surrogate mean-std margin)
direct gap, with the PBE-level check that G is the CBM
each strain component |e_i| <= 0.08 (Voigt 6 components, tensor shear)
Born stability required (all stiffness eigenvalues > 0)
formalization.level_of_theory: search: PBE DFT + per-valley HSE06 scissor; the final HSE06 check was not run
formalization.subspace: full 6-component GL strain, bound 0.08 per component
formalization.stability: Born stiffness eigenvalues > 0 at the strained state. NOT checked by me: elastic_stability was denied. The previous verifier found the old, similar all-tensile state stable (min eigenvalue 27.5 GPa), but this is not proof for the new state.

formalization.objective: minimise elastic strain energy density h(ε) in meV/Å^3

formalization.stability: Born elastic stability (all stiffness eigenvalues > 0) at the chosen strain. NOT assessed: the tool call was denied.
